
```sql
    CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS CI_DEPLOYER 
    PASSWORD = 'YourSecurePassword123!'
    DEFAULT_ROLE = CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE
    DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE = COMPUTE_WH
    DEFAULT_NAMESPACE = SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC
    COMMENT = 'Service account for CI/CD deployments via GitHub Actions';
```
```sql
    CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
```

```sql
    -- Step 3: Grant the role to the user
    GRANT ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE TO USER CI_DEPLOYER;

    -- Step 4: Grant warehouse usage
    GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 5: Grant database and schema permissions
    GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 6: Grant permissions on existing tables
    GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON ALL TABLES 
        IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 7: Grant permissions on future tables
    GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON FUTURE TABLES 
        IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 8: Grant object creation privileges
    GRANT CREATE TABLE ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE VIEW ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE STAGE ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE FILE FORMAT ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE SEQUENCE ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE PIPE ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE PROCEDURE ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT CREATE FUNCTION ON SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 9: Grant permissions on existing views, procedures, functions
    GRANT SELECT ON ALL VIEWS IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT USAGE ON ALL PROCEDURES IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT USAGE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 10: Grant permissions on future objects
    GRANT SELECT ON FUTURE VIEWS IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT USAGE ON FUTURE PROCEDURES IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT USAGE ON FUTURE FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;

    -- Step 11: Grant permissions on stages (for Snowflake CLI deployments)
    GRANT READ, WRITE ON ALL STAGES IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
    GRANT READ, WRITE ON FUTURE STAGES IN SCHEMA SNOWFLAKE_LEARNING_DB.PUBLIC TO ROLE CI_DEPLOYER_ROLE;
```
